title: The Painted Portrait
author: Juniper Lockridge
blurb: Noor Lockridge, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
